strategies.purpose: Publish owner-approved Caught Up editions from its own verified release history.
strategies.audience: Czech and English readers following bounded daily AI industry reporting.

contentPillars.label: Verified AI context
contentPillars.description: Evidence-led operating context that stays useful without forcing a news claim.

recurringFormats.label: Evidence commentary plan
evidenceRequirements: Use only verified edition or explicitly recorded owned evidence before final copy.
recurringFormats.deterministicBriefTemplate: Prepare a dated evidence-commentary brief; omit the candidate if no verified source exists.

recurringFormats.label: Change watch reserve
evidenceRequirements: Name the exact recorded change evidence before final copy.
recurringFormats.deterministicBriefTemplate: Hold a reserve brief for one verified change and state why it matters.

recurringFormats.label: Context card slot
evidenceRequirements: Visual facts require claim references and Design Lab output.
recurringFormats.deterministicBriefTemplate: Plan one source-bound context card; Design Lab remains the only renderer.

claims: Invented quote, testimonial, personal experience or unsupported prediction.
formats: Engagement bait, impersonation, automated reply or direct message.

localeToneGuidance.guidance: Clear Czech context, short sentences and no translated hype.
Concise operator context with explicit evidence boundaries.

stopConditions: Stop when verified evidence is unavailable, duplicated, stale or outside the profile purpose.

strategies.purpose: Publish owner-approved MMA Files editorial releases from the venture's own evidence.
strategies.audience: Readers following factual MMA event and roster coverage.

contentPillars.label: Fight context

recurringFormats.label: Event context plan
evidenceRequirements: Require the exact MMA Files event or roster evidence before final copy.
recurringFormats.deterministicBriefTemplate: Prepare one factual event-context brief with no odds, pick or invented quote.

recurringFormats.label: Roster watch reserve
evidenceRequirements: Require a current roster source and record its freshness.

evidenceRequirements: Use Design Lab and evidence-backed event-card fields.
